comment.caption: DT
comment.note: First installation process of muon barrel packages (DT + RPC) into the pockets of the CMS iron yoke at SX5. The chambers are first transported in groups of four from the ISR area (where they are certified and coupled together) to the construction hall in Cessy (Point 5 or SX5). Once there, they pass through a fast high voltage and electronic certification test, before being slid into the insertion cradle. This cradle is attached to the yoke and aligned to the chamber rails, allowing an easy insertion. More pictures on cds: http://documents.cern.ch/cgi-bin/setlink?base=PHO&categ=photo-cms&id=oreach-2004-004
